card.name: The word Tablets after a drug name
card.fires_on: The word Tablets (or Tablet) right after a drug name, most often at the start of a Contraindications section where the drug is named as the subject.

modes.label: Tablets in contraindications
modes.description: Tablets or Tablet follows the drug name in the opening sentence of a CONTRAINDICATIONS section.
modes.example: CONTRAINDICATIONS Doxazosin<< Tablets>>, USP are contraindicated

modes.label: Tablets elsewhere in label
modes.description: Tablets follows a drug name in instructions or warnings outside the contraindications heading.
modes.example: Patients with hematological manifestations of bone marrow depression must take Benznidazole<< Tablets>> only under strict medical supervision.

card.plain: It lights up on the word Tablets when it comes straight after a drug's name, especially in the Contraindications heading.
